decks.name: LeetCode #217 - Contains Duplicate
decks.description: Determine if an array contains any duplicate values

cards.question: Contains Duplicate: Given an integer array nums, return true if any value appears at least twice in the array, and return false if every element is distinct.

solutions.name: Hash Set
solutions.explanation: Use a hash set to track seen numbers. For each number, check if it already exists in the set. If yes, we found a duplicate. If no, add it to the set. Most efficient solution with linear time.

solutions.explanation: Add all numbers to a hash set, then compare the set size with the array length. If the set is smaller, duplicates exist. This approach processes all elements before checking, unlike the early-return approach.

solutions.explanation: Sort the array first, then check adjacent elements. If any two adjacent elements are equal, we found a duplicate. More space-efficient than hash set but slower due to sorting.
